skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The clothes Ch'en wore on her first visit to Baizao.
By changing back into that familiar Yanese style, her wandering heart has taken its first step towards the land of her family.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
She stole into the capital under cover of night, and in that same night, turned to leave.
The land she seeks is shrouded in eternal darkness, but with her sword and her grit, she will slice through the night, and bring about a new dawn.
